Banana producers in Latin America are calling for better pay to help cope with the impact of the climate crisis, as they face big drops in production resulting from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event.

In the Dominican Republic, farmers are expected to face drought conditions, with forecasts of drier and warmer than usual conditions.

articles.title: Many Cubans voted for Trump - now they're turning on Republican immigration policies

articles.title: Beyond the beaches: The Dominican Republic and the global debate over deep-sea mining
articles.description: The DR wanted science to keep advancing and the International Seabed Authority to finish building the regulatory framework that the UN Convention had mandated it to develop.
articles.titleJa: ビーチを越えて：ドミニカ共和国と深海採掘に関する世界的議論

articles.title: Venezuela welcomes opposition leader María Corina Machado home

articles.title: What comes after networked authoritarianism?

articles.titleJa: ネットワーク型権威主義の次に何が来るのか？
articles.summary: 10月の特集は、ビッグテックと権威主義の関係に焦点を当て、世界の多くの国々におけるテクノロジー企業と政治的関係を探った。

articles.title: The scandals and suspects surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro, according to the Brazilian press
articles.description: The former president's eldest son, Flávio, had been linked to embezzlement charges in his own cabinet. During the campaign, however, his resume was exposed even further
articles.titleJa: ブラジル報道機関による、フラビオ・ボルソナロを巡るスキャンダルと容疑者たち
articles.summary: 元大統領の長男フラビオ・ボルソナロは、横領容疑に関与しており、選挙戦でその経歴がさらに暴かれた。

articles.title: The Brazilian left’s quest to ‘tame’ Meta: A narrative of denouncement and resistance
articles.description: In our October edition of Undertones, we examine a movement calling for accountability and coordinated online action to challenge Meta’s problematic content moderation policies and governance practices in Brazil.

articles.title: How the streets and a social media army led Lula to a historic win in Brazil
articles.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
articles.titleJa: 街頭とソーシャルメディア軍がルーラをブラジルの歴史的勝利に導いた経緯

articles.title: Warning Signals: Venezuela and the Risk of AI-Powered Chinese Digital Authoritarianism

articles.titleJa: 警鐘：ベネズエラとAI駆動の中国型デジタル権威主義のリスク
articles.summary: ベネズエラが中国のAIを監視システムに統合し、デジタル統制を拡大する可能性について、豪州のシンクタンクが警鐘を鳴らす。

articles.title: Queer mediums of the cult of María Lionza are redefining the gender binary in Venezuela’s sacred mountain
articles.description: An ethnographic look at Venezuela's María Lionza cult, examining how LGBTQ+ mediums challenge traditional gender roles and face discrimination while channeling diverse spiritual entities
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの聖なる山でマリア・リオンサ信仰のクィアな霊媒師がジェンダー二元性を再定義
articles.summary: ベネズエラのマリア・リオンサ信仰におけるLGBTQ+の霊媒師が、伝統的なジェンダー役割に挑戦し、差別と向き合う様子を民族誌的に探る。

articles.title: In Brazil’s elections, big techs’ transparency and cooperation policies translate as governance washing, according to this expert
articles.description: “Under normal conditions, this is already serious enough, because the platform rules over the information flow in a society, but when you apply it to an electoral dispute, it's even more serious.”
articles.titleJa: ブラジル選挙における大手テック企業の透明性と協力政策は、この専門家によると「ガバナンス・ウォッシング」である
articles.summary: 専門家は、大手テック企業の透明性政策が、情報流通を支配する深刻な問題であり、選挙ではさらに重要だと指摘する。

articles.title: Venezuela faces a deepening energy crisis as protests grow
articles.description: Venezuela’s worsening electricity crisis is disrupting daily life, pushing frustrated residents into the streets as prolonged blackouts expose the fragility of the country’s power grid.

articles.summary: ベネズエラの電力危機が悪化し、長期停電が国民生活を混乱させ、抗議活動が激化している。

articles.title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
articles.description: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.

articles.summary: 予備結果は非常に意見が分かれた議会を示唆し、連立協議が数週間続く可能性。

articles.title: He spent $50,000 on Labubus but now the craze is dying

articles.summary: ポップマートの売上は減少。奇妙な収集モンスターへの関心が薄れているため。

articles.title: New Zealand election 'too close to call' - so who will be next PM?
articles.description: With the New Zealand election too tight to call, the BBC's Tiffanie Turnbull reports from a Labour Party gathering after an inconclusive night.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド総選挙は「接戦で予断を許さない」—次期首相は誰に？
articles.summary: BBCのティファニー・ターンブルが労働党の集会から報告。総選挙は接戦で結果は不確定。

articles.title: An Indian film that nobody would release is finally a hit - 18 awards later
articles.description: Extraordinary scenes of audiences crying leaving theatres after watching the film have been shared on social media.
articles.titleJa: 誰も公開したがらなかったインド映画が18冠受賞後ついにヒット
articles.summary: 映画鑑賞後に観客が泣きながら劇場を後にする感動的なシーンがSNSで話題に。

articles.title: Australian woman shot during Bondi Beach attack dies almost a year later
articles.description: The 90-year-old was among those seriously injured after gunmen opened fire at a Jewish event last year.
articles.titleJa: ボンダイビーチ襲撃事件で負傷したオーストラリア人女性が約1年後に死亡
articles.summary: 昨年ユダヤ系イベントで銃撃された際、重傷を負った90歳の女性が亡くなった。

articles.title: Watch: Moment woman rescues young koala from large snake
articles.description: Nell was walking her dog in Brisbane, Australia, when she saw a distressed koala trying to protect its joey from a python.

articles.summary: オーストラリアのブリスベンで、犬の散歩中にコアラの親子がヘビに襲われるのを目撃し救出。

articles.title: Macau jails pro-democracy campaigner in city's first national security case
articles.description: Au Kam San was sentenced to 12 years and six months' jail for "subversion against the political power of the state".
articles.titleJa: マカオで初の国家安全保障事件、民主活動家を投獄
articles.summary: アウ・カムサンが「国家政権転覆」の罪で12年6ヶ月の懲役刑を言い渡された。

articles.title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
articles.description: Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law.
articles.titleJa: 香港民主化デモの顔、ジョシュア・ウォンが10年の禁固刑に
articles.summary: 30歳のウォンは、物議を醸す国家安全維持法の下で拘束された数百人の香港人の一人。

articles.title: Italian chef fired after refusing to put pineapple on pizza
articles.description: He had told his employer, an Australian restaurant, that pineapple on pizza was "offensive" to Italian culture.
articles.titleJa: ピザにパイナップルを乗せるのを拒否し、イタリア人シェフが解雇
articles.summary: オーストラリアのレストランで、イタリア文化への冒涜としてパイナップルピザを拒否し解雇された。

articles.title: Australia's oldest department store David Jones folds after 188 years
articles.description: The brand's 38 physical stores and online site will continue to operate while receivers review its operations.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリア最古の百貨店デイビッド・ジョーンズが188年の歴史に幕
articles.summary: ブランドの38の実店舗とオンラインサイトは営業を継続し、管財人が運営を審査する。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
articles.description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定のPET樹脂化学品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: EUは2026年11月6日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート樹脂化学品の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通報した。

articles.title: Director-General: Leverage trade and partnerships to build a resilient ocean economy
articles.description: The multilateral trading system provides important tools for the development of a healthy and prosperous ocean economy, Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her keynote speech at an event on Trade, Biodiversity and the Ocean Economy: Pathways to Resilience at the WTO on 5 November. Highlighting the importance of strengthening support for coastal and island economies, she said: Trade is part of the answer. The oceans are an asset of the global commons that can best be managed through multilateral approaches. The event was co-organized by Belgium, Fiji and Portugal.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長：強靭な海洋経済を築くため貿易とパートナーシップを活用する
articles.summary: WTO事務局長は、強靭な海洋経済構築のために多国間貿易システムとパートナーシップの重要性を強調。沿岸・島嶼経済支援の必要性も述べた。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
articles.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：ベトナム
articles.summary: ベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回レビューが2026年11月4日と6日に開催される。WTO事務局とベトナム政府の報告書が基礎となる。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain new hybrid vehicles
articles.description: On 30 October 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (30 October 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain new hybrid vehicles.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定の新型ハイブリッド車に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: EUは2026年10月30日、特定の新型ハイブリッド車の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通報した。

articles.title: Transparency remains core priority in work of subsidies committee
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures (SCM) on 30 October 2026, the Chair of the Committee - Raimondas Alisauskas (Lithuania) - expressed serious concern over persistently low compliance with subsidy notification obligations. He stressed that timely and complete notifications are both an obligation under the SCM Agreement and a shared interest, particularly as transparency gains prominence in WTO reform discussions.
articles.titleJa: 補助金委員会の活動において透明性が引き続き最優先事項
articles.summary: 補助金・相殺措置委員会は、補助金通知義務の遵守率の低さに懸念を表明。透明性がWTO改革の焦点となる中で、迅速で完全な通知の重要性を強調した。

articles.title: Global Review concludes with a declaration on partnerships for trade and development
articles.description: Marking the 20th anniversary of the Aid for Trade Initiative, WTO members adopted a declaration on 30 October repositioning the initiative as "Aid for Trade: partnerships for trade and development". The declaration was adopted at a meeting of the Committee on Trade and Development, which wrapped up the two-day 10th Global Review of Aid for Trade held at WTO headquarters in Geneva.
articles.titleJa: グローバルレビュー、貿易と開発のためのパートナーシップに関する宣言で締めくくり
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は、「貿易のための援助：貿易と開発のためのパートナーシップ」として、貿易のための援助イニシアチブの20周年を記念する宣言を採択した。

articles.title: New report looks at role of South-South and triangular cooperation for trade development
articles.description: The growing importance of trade between developing economies - South-South trade - is highlighted in a joint publication launched on Day 1 (29 October) of the 10th Global Review of Aid for Trade by the WTO and the United Nations Office for South-South Cooperation (UNOSSC). The publication examines how the partnerships fostered through South-South cooperation and triangular cooperation – South-South partnerships supported by a developed economy - are helping strengthen developing economies' trade capacities and facilitate market access.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、貿易開発における南南協力と三角協力の役割を検証
articles.summary: WTOと国連南南協力室の共同報告書は、南南貿易の重要性を強調し、南南協力と三角協力が途上国の貿易能力強化と市場アクセス促進にどう役立つかを探る。

articles.title: Members review 34 notifications, share experiences at Fisheries Subsidies Committee
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Fisheries Subsidies on 29 October, WTO members conducted the first review of notifications under the WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies and shared experiences on how they are implementing the Agreement since it entered into force just over a year ago.
articles.titleJa: 漁業補助金委員会で34の通知をレビューし、経験を共有
articles.summary: 漁業補助金委員会で、WTO加盟国は漁業補助金協定に基づく通知の最初のレビューを実施し、協定発効後1年間の実施経験を共有した。

articles.title: Cotton partners launch drive to bring textile/garment investment to West, Central Africa
articles.description: On the margins of the Global Aid for Trade Review, the Partenariat pour le Coton (PPC – the Cotton Partnership) launched an Investment Promotion Drive on 29 October to help Africa’s farmers move from exporting cotton as raw fibre to increasing participation in higher-value activities, such as garment manufacturing. The aim of the drive is to connect investment with on-the-ground projects that will generate jobs and economic growth.
articles.titleJa: 綿花パートナー、西アフリカ・中央アフリカへの繊維・衣料品投資促進活動を開始
articles.summary: 綿花パートナーシップは、西アフリカ・中央アフリカにおける綿花産業の高付加価値化と雇用創出を目的とした投資促進活動を開始した。

articles.title: Global Review 2026 spotlights partnerships for trade and development
articles.description: "Developing economies seeking trade success need stronger partnerships with all stakeholders," WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her opening remarks at the 2026 Global Review on 29 October, marking 20 years of the Aid for Trade initiative. Over two days, ministers, heads of international organizations and trade and development experts will take stock of the initiative's impact, discuss evolving trade needs and explore how stronger partnerships can help developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs), turn trade opportunities into economic growth, jobs and better livelihoods.
articles.titleJa: グローバルレビュー2026、貿易と開発のためのパートナーシップに焦点
articles.summary: WTO事務局長は、貿易のための援助イニシアチブ20周年を記念するグローバルレビューで、途上国の貿易成功にはより強力なパートナーシップが必要だと強調した。
